name: Vitaleco
description: Montevideo specialist in high-end kitchen appliances: espresso and coffee machines, cold-press juicers, blenders, dehydrators, stand mixers and water purifiers from brands such as Philips, De'Longhi, KitchenAid, Bosch, Krups and Cuisinart. Ships only within Uruguay.
description_es: Especialista de Montevideo en electrodomésticos de cocina de alta gama: cafeteras espresso, jugueras cold press, licuadoras, deshidratadores, batidoras planetarias y purificadores de agua de marcas como Philips, De'Longhi, KitchenAid, Bosch, Krups y Cuisinart. Envía solo dentro de Uruguay.

ships_to.notes: Home delivery nationwide; free on selected products or promotions, otherwise the cost is shown at checkout.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Orders can be collected at postal agencies nationwide.

endpoints.notes: Plain-text llms.txt published by the store for AI assistants.

shopping_notes: Shopify store: /search/suggest.json and /products.json return structured product data with prices in Uruguayan pesos, and the store publishes a storefront MCP endpoint, a UCP profile and an llms.txt agent guide. Product titles include the brand and model when the brand uses one.

sources.supports: ships only within Uruguay; postal agency pickup
agent guide published by the store
